column3: n. 类人猿;a. 似人的
column5: Field researchers followed a troop of anthropoid apes through the mountain forest.
column6: 野外研究者跟随一群类人猿穿越山地森林。

column3: a. 有斑的, 有斑纹的
column5: A brindled cow stood alone in the misty field beside the barn.
column6: 一头斑纹母牛独自站在谷仓旁雾气弥漫的田里。

column3: 泄出, 排出, 排出物, 臭气
column5: Noxious effluvia from the tannery drifted across the river into the town.
column6: 制革厂的恶臭废气飘过河面,蔓延到镇上。

column3: vt. 放弃, 舍弃, 克制(欲望)
column5: She chose to abnegate the title rather than defend a broken system.
column6: 她宁可放弃头衔,也不愿为一个千疮百孔的制度辩护。

column3: vt. 厌恶, 憎恶
column5: The essayist abominates the shallow certainty that spreads so quickly online.
column6: 这位随笔作者痛恨网上迅速蔓延的浅薄笃定。

column3: adv. 光明正大地, 率直地;a. 光明正大的, 率直的
column5: The whole transaction was aboveboard, with every payment recorded and audited.
column6: 整笔交易光明正大,每一笔款项都有记录并经审计。

column3: n. 切断, 除去;切除
column5: In autumn, trees trigger leaf abscission as daylight hours steadily shorten.
column6: 入秋后,随着日照不断缩短,树木启动落叶过程。

column3: a. 有节制的
column5: His abstentious habits surprised colleagues who expected lavish entertaining from a director.
column6: 他饮食有节的习惯让同事意外,大家本以为总监会讲排场。

column3: a. 不结果的,无果实的
column5: The drought left the orchard acarpous, without a single fruit forming.
column6: 干旱过后果园颗粒无收,连一颗果子都没结。

column3: n. 恐高症;高处恐怖
column5: His acrophobia made stepping onto the glass observation deck an act of courage.
column6: 恐高症让走上玻璃观景台成了一次勇气考验。

column3: v. 临时穿插, 信口说出, 即兴讲演;状态说明设计语言
column5: The actor forgot his lines and had to adlib through the entire final scene.
column6: 演员忘了台词,最后整整一场戏只能临场即兴。

column3: vt. 谄媚, 过分称赞
column5: The press adulated the young conductor until his first poorly reviewed season.
column6: 媒体把年轻指挥捧上了天,直到他首个演出季恶评如潮。

column3: n. 大团, 大块;a. 成块的, 聚结的
column5: Over decades the suburbs agglomerated into a single continuous metropolitan belt.
column6: 数十年间,城郊逐渐聚合成连绵一体的都市带。

column3: vt. 使委屈, 使悲痛, 侵害;侵害, 使悲痛, 使委屈
column5: Deeply aggrieved tenants filed complaints after rents rose without any notice.
column6: 租金毫无预兆上涨后,愤懑的租户纷纷投诉。

column3: v. 用头韵法, 押头韵
column5: The headline's words deliberately alliterate so readers remember the story.
column6: 标题刻意押了头韵,让读者记住这条新闻。

column3: n. 先, 居先, 先行
column5: The patent case turned on the antecedence of two nearly identical filings.
column6: 这桩专利案的关键在于两份几乎相同的申请孰先孰后。

column3: n. 作者（或真实性、权威性）可疑的著作；旁经
column5: Historians treat the memoir's stranger passages as apocrypha rather than documented fact.
column6: 历史学家把回忆录中较为离奇的段落视为传闻而非信史。

column3: n. 格言, 箴言
column5: The old general reduced his whole philosophy to a single terse apothegm.
column6: 老将军把毕生哲思浓缩成一句简短的格言。

column3: a. 散光的, 矫正散光的;象散
column5: The astigmatic typesetter squinted at fine print without his thick spectacles.
column6: 患散光的排字工不戴上厚眼镜就眯眼细看小字。

column3: a. 使人畏惧的
column5: The glacier's blue ice wall was truly awe-inspiring in the morning light.
column6: 晨光之中,冰川的蓝色冰壁确实令人叹为观止。

column3: n. 挫折, 倒退, 逆流, 涡流
column5: The recovery suffered a backset when the second wave of storms arrived.
column6: 第二波风暴来袭,恢复工作又遭受了一次挫折。

column3: vt. 俗丽地打扮(或装饰)
column5: The carnival floats were bedizened with foil ribbons and painted paper flowers.
column6: 狂欢节花车被锡纸彩带和纸画花装点得俗艳夺目。

column3: vt. 痛打;殴打, 鞭打, 辱骂
column5: The professor tends to belabor points the class understood twenty minutes earlier.
column6: 教授总爱反复讲解全班二十分钟前就懂的要点。

column3: vt. 围, 围攻
column5: The beleaguered mayor faced protests, budget shortfalls, and a hostile press.
column6: 焦头烂额的市长同时面对抗议、预算缺口和敌意媒体。

column3: n. 祝福
column5: The pilgrims departed with the abbot's benison still echoing in the courtyard.
column6: 朝圣者启程时,院中仍回荡着修道院院长的祝福。

column3: a. 饮酒的, 嗜酒的, 吸水的;吸水的
column5: His bibulous evenings slowly cost him the respect of the whole firm.
column6: 他夜夜贪杯,渐渐失去了全公司上下的敬重。

column3: n. 百叶窗；盲人（常用复数）
column5: She pulled the blinds shut against the glare of the afternoon sun.
column6: 她拉上百叶窗,挡住午后刺眼的阳光。

column3: a. 凶兆的, 预兆的;n. 凶兆, 前兆, 预感
column5: The villagers read the strange red sky as a boding of storms.
column6: 村民们把罕见的红天解读为暴风雨的凶兆。

column3: a. 无用的, 无益的;无益的, 无用的
column5: Their bootless search for the missing manuscript continued deep into the night.
column6: 他们寻找失踪手稿的徒劳搜寻一直持续到深夜。

column3: vt. 删除, 删改
column5: Modern editors restored the passages that cautious publishers once bowdlerized.
column6: 现代编辑把当年被谨小慎微的出版商删改的段落补了回来。
